meta.title: Agent Mode Change
meta.description: A freely draggable Web-UI window that switches the current session's system prompt between DeepSeek Harness's own prompt and 13 archived coding-agent CLI prompts (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity, Grok, Kimi, MiniMax Code, opencode, Pi…). Switching runs the official /agent command, so the session log stays traceable.
